identification.name: PEEK (Polyether Ether Ketone)
identification.common_form_notes: Stock shapes in round bar and plate are the most common for machined components
identification.notes: Unfilled (natural) grade, equivalent to Victrex PEEK 450G. PEEK is semi-crystalline and has both a glass transition (Tg = 143°C onset, 150°C midpoint) and a melting point (Tm = 343°C). Maximum continuous service temperature 250°C in air. Outstanding chemical resistance to most solvents, fuels, and acids. Filled grades (glass-fibre, carbon-fibre, PTFE) improve stiffness, creep resistance, and/or tribology at the cost of ductility. CTE is anisotropic in injection-moulded parts: 45 µm/m·K along flow, 55 µm/m·K average (both below Tg); rises to 120–140 µm/m·K above Tg. Value stored is average below Tg. Shore D 84.5 per ISO 868; no Rockwell M published in TDS. Thermal diffusivity derived from k, ρ, Cp.

typical_usage: High-performance structural components where metals are too heavy and standard plastics lack temperature or chemical resistance: aerospace brackets, medical implants and instruments, semiconductor processing fixtures, pump and valve internals, and bearing cages.
